example_sentences_in_bangla: বসন্তকালকে ঋতুরাজ বলে অভিহিত করা হয়।
ঋতুরাজ এলে প্রকৃতি রঙিন হয়ে ওঠে।
example_sentences_in_english: Spring is referred to as the king of seasons.
When the king of seasons arrives, nature becomes colorful.
note: Commonly used in Bengali poetry and songs to evoke the vibrancy of spring.
